en.hubeali: H 14557 – And by this chain, from Hafs, who has reported the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘The one who wants to travel so he should do so on the day of Saturday. Even if a stone falls off a mountain on the day of Saturday, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Return it to its place. And the one who is unable to fulfill his need should seek it on the day of Tuesday, for it is the day in which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Softened the iron for Dawood<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 109. And by this chain, from Hafs, who has reported the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘The one who wants to travel so he should do so on the day of Saturday. Even if a stone falls off a mountain on the day of Saturday, Allah (azwj) would Return it to its place. And the one who is unable to fulfill his need should seek it on the day of Tuesday, for it is the day in which Allah (azwj) Softened the iron for Dawood (as)’.
